decisions.statement: The services are read from the file the service writes rather than assembled.
The panel shows the services that file has before any change to that file arrives.
The panel shows them again when that file is written and at no other time.
A file written while the panel is hidden is kept rather than shown.
A panel becoming visible with a showing owed shows the services the file last said.
The rows the file has are shown unchanged rather than spelled again.
The rows counted are all the rows.
The services counted are the rows that are one service rather than a kind.
The kinds counted are the rows that are a kind rather than the top row.
The badge counts rows while the description counts services.
The description counts the rows a filter matched while that filter is there.
No watcher on a source file is registered here.
Nothing here decides a row's appearance.

definition: the Services panel brought up, and the services put into it from one file
